  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "NumStability.FiniteVolumeCellPartition",
      "interpretation": "By its supplied constructor D005, a nonempty indexed family of measurable, pairwise disjoint regions covering a specified domain. The index type need not be finite.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the cells receiving assignments and their measurable averaging regions.",
      "source_match": "Represents the domain divided into grid cells on printed page 5. Exact disjointness can be realized by assigning shared boundaries to one cell.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "NumStability.FiniteVolumeCellPartition.cellRegion",
      "interpretation": "Projection of the partition's region-valued field.",
      "effect_on_target": "The same cell region is used in volume, integrability, averaging, and locality.",
      "source_match": "Matches averaging over the volume enclosed by the relevant cell on printed page 8.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "NumStability.IsCellVolumeAverage",
      "interpretation": "Conjunction of nonzero measure, finite measure, integrability on the region, and equality to the specified normalized integral.",
      "effect_on_target": "Constrains each assigned value to one fixed averaging construction; uniqueness is restricted to assignments satisfying this predicate.",

      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "NumStability.cellVolumeAverage",
      "interpretation": "The Bochner integral with respect to the restricted measure, scaled by the reciprocal of the real-valued region measure.",

      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "NumStability.FiniteVolumeCellPartition.mk",

      "source_match": "A standard measurable representation of grid cells; imposes no regularity on the material field beyond the separately supplied integrability.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "And",
      "interpretation": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all four conclusion clauses simultaneously and all conditions inside D003.",
      "source_match": "No alternative or conditional replacement of the cellwise assignment claim occurs.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "CompleteSpace",
      "interpretation": "Completeness of the supplied uniform space, here induced by the parameter norm.",

      "source_match": "A suitable analytic setting for the selected integral construction, including ordinary finite-dimensional material parameter spaces; not a printed hypothesis.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "interpretation": "Projects the function represented by a function-like structure.",

      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ENNReal",
      "interpretation": "Nonnegative real numbers extended by a top element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows region measures to be zero, positive finite, or infinite before hypotheses exclude exceptional values.",
      "source_match": "Supports the positive finite volume conditions of the recorded convention.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Eq",
      "interpretation": "Exact equality, including equality of functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses the prescribed average, uniqueness, locality, and constant reproduction.",
      "source_match": "These are exact properties of the selected mathematical average, not numerical accuracy guarantees.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Exists",
      "interpretation": "Existential quantification.",

      "status": "pass"

      "source_match": "Infrastructure for the selected integration convention, without imposing continuity of the medium.",
      "status": "pass"

    {

      "name": "MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn",
      "interpretation": "Integrability of the field with respect to the measure restricted to the region.",

      "status": "pass"

    {

      "name": "Ne",
